description: This PHP file defines the LeaveTypeService class which is part of the OrangeHRM HR management system. It provides methods for managing leave types, including retrieving leave types for employees and converting leave type objects into arrays with normalized data. It uses traits for additional services and interacts with data access objects (DAOs) and models related to leave types.

classes.name: LeaveTypeService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling leave type operations such as retrieving leave types, checking employee eligibility for leave types, and converting leave type objects into normalized arrays with internationalization support.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LeaveTypeDao object used for data access operations related to leave types.

methods.name: getEligibleLeaveTypesByEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns a list of leave types that an employee is eligible for, optionally including leave types with allocated leaves.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeAsArray
methods.description: Fetches a leave type by its ID and returns an array representation with normalized data, appending a 'deleted' label if applicable.
